source: Per-company AR extraction (Screener.in PDFs + IR sites) — Claude.ai routine, daily batch of 20

rural.evidence: Company explicitly cites 'Emerging India' (rural/semi-urban) as a structural growth driver, with growth in Emerging India consistently outpacing Urban Markets across quarters in FY2025.

govt_capex.evidence: Construction chemicals (Dr. Fixit) has incidental exposure to infrastructure projects, but government capex is not a primary revenue driver. No quantified government revenue disclosed.

rate_sensitive.evidence: Pidilite is nearly debt-free with negligible interest expense. No material floating rate liability exposure.

crude_exposure.evidence: Approximately 50% of Pidilite's raw materials are crude oil derivatives. VAM (Vinyl Acetate Monomer) accounts for ~60% of raw material costs and is a crude derivative. Raw materials constitute ~45% of revenue (EBITDA margin ~23-24%).

inr_exposure.hedging_policy: International subsidiaries operate in local currencies; limited direct USD revenue. Company manages transactional forex risk through forward contracts.
inr_exposure.evidence: International subsidiaries (Dubai, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Thailand, Egypt, USA, Brazil) grew 6-9% in FY2025, representing approximately 13% of consolidated revenue. Direct export from India is minimal.

pli_scheme.evidence: No PLI scheme applicability for adhesives or specialty consumer chemicals. Pidilite not mentioned as PLI beneficiary in FY2025.

rural.evidence: Royal Enfield motorcycles are positioned in the mid-size segment sold through urban and semi-urban dealerships. Rural exposure not quantified and not a primary strategic narrative.

govt_capex.evidence: VECV (Eicher's JV with Volvo for trucks/buses) has some exposure to government fleet and infrastructure purchases, but no quantified government capex revenue is disclosed.

rate_sensitive.evidence: Eicher Motors is net-cash positive with minimal debt. No material floating rate liability exposure.

crude_exposure.evidence: Key raw materials are steel, aluminum, and rubber. Royal Enfield EBITDA margin was ~24% in FY2025. Exact raw material cost as % of revenue not disclosed in public sources reviewed.

inr_exposure.hedging_policy: Company manages forex risk through natural hedges (CKD assembly plants in Thailand, Bangladesh) and forward contracts. International revenue ~10% of consolidated.
inr_exposure.evidence: Royal Enfield exported 100,136 motorcycles in FY2025 (29.7% growth YoY), ~10% of total motorcycle volumes. Revenue from 60+ countries including UK, Australia, Southeast Asia, Latin America.

pli_scheme.evidence: Eicher Motors is among the eight OEM applicants under the PLI Auto scheme (Champion OEM category) that received DVA certification for electric models. PLI scheme extended through FY28.

rural.evidence: Ajanta Pharma's India business (Rs 1,452 cr in FY2025, 31% of revenue) is primarily branded generic formulations sold through retail chemists in urban/semi-urban India. No disclosed rural revenue percentage.

govt_capex.evidence: Ajanta Pharma operates in branded generics and specialty formulations — no material government tender or institutional business.

rate_sensitive.evidence: Ajanta Pharma is nearly debt-free (debt-to-equity ~0%). No material floating rate liability.

crude_exposure.evidence: Raw materials are APIs, intermediates, and packaging — not crude-linked. EBITDA margin 27% in FY2025. No significant crude oil derivative exposure.

inr_exposure.hedging_policy: Company hedges forex receivables through forward contracts. US generics and Africa/Asia business denominated in USD and local currencies.
inr_exposure.evidence: FY2025 revenue: India Rs 1,452 cr (31.3%), US Rs 1,047 cr (22.5%), Asia Rs 1,191 cr (25.6%), Africa Rs 750 cr (16.1%), others ~Rs 208 cr (~4.5%). Total ~69% of revenues from international markets.

pli_scheme.evidence: Ajanta Pharma focuses on finished formulations, not bulk APIs/KSMs which are PLI pharma scheme targets. Not identified as a PLI beneficiary in FY2025.

china_plus_one.evidence: JB Pharma has regulatory approvals from US, UK, EU, Australia, South Africa, Russia/CIS and Japan and exports to 40+ countries. CDMO segment growing 18% in FY2025, but no explicit China+1 narrative identified in public FY2025 disclosures.

rural.evidence: JB Pharma's India domestic business (Rs 2,269 cr, 58% of revenue) is branded generics in chronic/acute therapy segments. No rural revenue separately disclosed.

govt_capex.evidence: JB Pharma operates in branded generics and CDMO. No material government institutional or tender business identified.

rate_sensitive.evidence: Gross debt decreased sharply to ~Rs 108 cr by mid-FY2025 (from Rs 815 cr historically). Company is nearly debt-free by FY2025.

crude_exposure.evidence: Raw materials are APIs, intermediates, and packaging. No material crude oil derivative exposure in formulations or CDMO business.

inr_exposure.hedging_policy: Company manages forex exposure through natural hedges and forward contracts. International formulations revenue in USD, ZAR, RUB.
inr_exposure.evidence: FY2025: Domestic Rs 2,269 cr (58%), International formulations Rs 1,128 cr (29%), CDMO Rs 446 cr (11%), API Rs 76 cr (2%). South Africa and US registered double-digit growth. Russia is a key branded generics market.

pli_scheme.evidence: JB Pharma focuses on finished formulations and CDMO. No PLI pharma scheme participation identified in FY2025 filings.

china_plus_one.evidence: Supply chain diversification trends including China+1 strategies by multinationals are boosting direct engagements and export opportunities for Navin Fluorine, evidenced by strategic global partnerships (e.g., Chemours for Opteon immersion cooling fluid, Buss ChemTech). Export contribution ranged from 57% (Q1FY25) to 77% (Q4FY25), averaging ~60% for the full year.

rate_sensitive.evidence: NFIL has undertaken significant capex (Rs 2,200 cr pipeline) funded through internal accruals and borrowings. Specific fixed vs. floating rate breakdown not found in public sources reviewed.

crude_exposure.evidence: Key raw material is fluorspar (calcium fluoride) and HF (hydrofluoric acid) — not crude oil derivatives. HPP refrigerant segment uses fluorine-based inputs. No significant crude oil linkage.

inr_exposure.hedging_policy: Company hedges forex receivables through forward contracts given high export intensity (60-77% of revenue). USD is primary export currency for CDMO and specialty chemicals.
inr_exposure.evidence: Q4FY25 export contribution was 77% of revenue; Q1FY25 was ~57%; full-year FY2025 estimated ~60%. FY2025 total revenue Rs 2,349 cr (HPP 51%, Specialty 34%, CDMO 15%).

pli_scheme.evidence: No PLI scheme participation identified for Navin Fluorine in FY2025. Specialty fluorochemicals are not covered under current PLI schemes.

rate_sensitive.evidence: Company is debt-free (zero borrowings as of FY2025). Rate sensitivity operates via AUM: equity MF mix at 44% of total AUM (Rs 4,056 billion Q4 FY25); debt/liquid AUM ~39% sensitive to rate movements. Market-linked AUM declines compress management fee revenue.

inr_exposure.evidence: ABSLAMC earns management fees on India-domiciled AUM; no material USD revenue. Offshore AIF/PMS AUM exists but revenue not separately quantified.

china_plus_one.evidence: Lupin Integrated Report FY2025: 'As the world seeks secure and diversified API sources, Lupin's API Plus business offers global customers credible, cost-effective, and high-quality solutions.' 'With global pharma companies diversifying away from China, India's CDMO market is projected to grow from USD 3.5 Bn to USD 25 Bn over the next decade.' Export momentum strong but no explicit China+1 revenue attribution.

crude_exposure.evidence: Gross margin consistently ~69% across FY2025 quarters (Q1 68.4%, Q2 69.3%, Q3 69.4%), implying cost of materials consumed ~31% of net revenue. Pharma materials include petrochemical-linked solvents and excipients.

inr_exposure.hedging_policy: Active layered hedging via natural hedges and forex derivatives covering USD-INR, EUR-INR, ZAR-INR exposures.
inr_exposure.evidence: US FY2025 sales USD 925 million (~38% of global revenue). 'Operating in 100+ markets exposes Lupin to currency fluctuations, particularly those of USD-INR, EUR-INR, and ZAR-INR. Lupin's treasury operations actively monitor exposures and adopt layered hedging strategies.'

pli_scheme.evidence: PLI scheme for bulk drugs/APIs referenced in sector context; Lupin's specific beneficiary status not confirmed in publicly available FY2025 disclosures.

rural.evidence: Tier-III and beyond cities contribute ~3% of Dr Lal PathLabs revenues, with 4-year CAGR of 17% for Tier-III+ vs overall 14% company CAGR. Annual Report FY2025 theme 'Expanding Access to Advanced Diagnostics' — management notes focus on 'Tier-3 and Tier-4 markets' and 'rural areas' infrastructure.

rate_sensitive.evidence: Company has minimal debt and strong cash generation; specific floating rate composition not disclosed.

crude_exposure.evidence: Cost of material consumed Rs 119.4 crore on revenue Rs 601.9 crore in Q1 FY25 (~19.8%). Materials include diagnostic reagents, consumables, lab supplies — some with petrochemical-derived components.

inr_exposure.evidence: Purely domestic diagnostics business; no USD revenue.

govt_capex.evidence: Indirect government exposure through EPC customers at ~35-40% of revenue. Key govt-capex driven sectors: railways/metro (traction drives and converters), power grid modernization (Electrification), renewables. CY2024 large orders up 20% driven by data centers and railways.

rate_sensitive.evidence: ABB India is net cash positive; finance costs rose 29.9% YoY in CY2024 but specific floating vs. fixed rate borrowing composition not disclosed.

crude_exposure.evidence: CY2024 revenue Rs 121,880 million, gross profit Rs 50,600 million (gross margin ~41.5%), implying cost of materials/COGS ~58.5% of revenue. Key materials: copper, steel, and petroleum-derived components (insulating oils, polymer insulators, coatings) used in transformers, switchgear, and motors.

inr_exposure.evidence: Export revenue ~10% of CY2024 revenue Rs 12,188 crore; exports grew 23% YoY driven by Distribution Solutions division.

pli_scheme.evidence: ABB India is not itself a PLI beneficiary but serves PLI-enabled customers. AR2024: 'Policy driven public sector capex, with investments in...incentivizing local production (PLI) in areas like specialty steel and battery manufacturing will augment the opportunity landscape.'

crude_exposure.evidence: Raw material expenses Rs 2,776 crore on FY2025 total revenue Rs 11,516 crore = 24.1%. Includes API intermediates and excipients with petrochemical linkages.

inr_exposure.evidence: US revenue Rs 1,100 crore (USD 130 million, ~10% of FY25 total). Germany Rs 1,139 crore (EUR 126 million, ~10%). Brazil Rs 1,100 crore (BRL 734 million, ~10%). No specific hedging policy details in publicly available summaries.

pli_scheme.evidence: No PLI scheme beneficiary mention found in publicly available FY2025 disclosures for Torrent Pharmaceuticals.

rural.evidence: India formulations (33% of revenue) are primarily branded generics sold through urban and semi-urban trade channels; rural exposure not separately disclosed.

rate_sensitive.evidence: Sun Pharma is largely debt-free at consolidated level; exact fixed vs floating split not publicly disclosed from FY25 AR.

crude_exposure.evidence: Material cost stands at 20.7% of sales for FY25, lower than last year on account of product mix including higher share of sales from Specialty business.

inr_exposure.hedging_policy: Company uses forward contracts and options to hedge USD and other currency receivables; detailed policy in annual report notes to accounts.
inr_exposure.evidence: ~67% of consolidated revenue is from outside India (US 31%, EM ~18%, Europe/RoW ~14%); forex hedging policy disclosed in annual report notes.

pli_scheme.evidence: Sun Pharma is primarily a formulations company; no confirmed PLI scheme beneficiary status found for FY25; PLI bulk drugs scheme is for API/KSM manufacturers.

china_plus_one.evidence: India is well-placed to capture more of the CRDMO market due to cost advantages, government support like the PLI scheme, and global efforts to diversify supply chains away from China. US Biosecure Act and China+1 supply-chain diversification strategy identified as key growth drivers for Sai Life Sciences in its FY2025 AR.

rate_sensitive.evidence: Company completed Rs 720 Cr debt repayment in FY25; post-repayment balance sheet significantly deleveraged; exact fixed/floating split not publicly disclosed.

crude_exposure.evidence: Three large suppliers accounted for 15% of raw material costs (April-September FY25). Chemical raw materials/solvents are primary inputs; crude linkage indirect through solvent costs.

inr_exposure.hedging_policy: Company uses derivative instruments (forward contracts, currency swaps, call-put options, interest rate swaps) to hedge forex exposure in line with risk management policy.
inr_exposure.evidence: ~95%+ of revenue from exports to global pharma/biotech clients billed predominantly in USD/EUR; hedging policy disclosed in annual report notes.

pli_scheme.evidence: PLI scheme cited as a key enabler for India's CRDMO sector growth; Sai Life Sciences identified as a beneficiary in sector context in FY2025 AR. Revenue from PLI not yet separately quantified.

china_plus_one.evidence: Sona Comstar entered a JV with China's Jinnaite Machinery Co. Ltd. (60% stake) to access China's EV market; no China+1 narrative present — strategy is supply into China rather than diversion away from it.

govt_capex.evidence: Acquired railway business of Escorts Kubota Limited, creating some exposure to Indian railways/govt capex, but revenue % not separately disclosed.

rate_sensitive.evidence: Raised Rs 2,400 crore via QIP in September 2024; balance sheet details on fixed vs floating rate borrowings not publicly disclosed.

crude_exposure.evidence: Primary raw material is steel/forged steel for precision forgings; indirect crude exposure through energy costs; no direct crude-based raw material.

inr_exposure.evidence: ~72% of revenue from international sales (North America ~36%, Europe ~24%, other ~12% for FY2025).

pli_scheme.evidence: Sona BLW Precision secured PLI certification for three new EV traction motor products under the Auto Components PLI scheme; PLI benefits included in Q4FY25 financials.

china_plus_one.evidence: Stronger momentum from China+1 identified as a key business trigger; management guided for double-digit growth for FY26 with China+1 as a catalyst; multi-source procurement strategy spanning US, EU, Middle East and Asia reflects supply-chain diversification.

rate_sensitive.evidence: No outstanding long-term debt; total debt comprises only working capital limits (cash credit, overdraft, lease liabilities). Effectively debt-free.

crude_exposure.evidence: Imported raw materials ~49% of raw material consumption in FY25 (vs 46% in FY24); key inputs are chemical raw materials and solvents with indirect crude linkage; raw material consumption ~Rs 3,700 crore in FY25 (approx 38% of revenue).

inr_exposure.hedging_policy: Company undertakes hedging transactions as and when required; imported RM (~49% of RM) provides natural hedge against INR depreciation.
inr_exposure.evidence: 88% of FY25 sales revenue derived from exports; Europe 56.46%, North America 16.18%, India 12.02%, Asia 11.35%, Rest of World 3.99%.

pli_scheme.evidence: No PLI beneficiary status confirmed for Divi's Labs in FY25; company is API/custom synthesis focused but not in the PLI bulk drugs scheme beneficiary list based on available disclosures.

rural.evidence: Tractor segment is part of Powertrain Solutions division with rural linkage; exact rural revenue % not disclosed. Tractor segment drove growth in FY25 Powertrain Solutions division.

govt_capex.evidence: Government's forward-looking policies including PLI scheme cited in annual report as underpinning strategic investments; no direct govt capex revenue % disclosed.

rate_sensitive.evidence: Bosch India is largely debt-free; borrowing details and fixed/floating split not disclosed in public coverage.

crude_exposure.evidence: Raw material and component costs for FY25 amounted to approximately Rs 7,425 crore, ~41% of total revenue of Rs 18,087 crore. Primary inputs are steel, electronic components, plastics; indirect crude exposure through plastics and energy.

inr_exposure.evidence: Domestic sales for Mobility business rose 6.2% in FY25; Powertrain Solutions exports grew; exact export % of total revenue not publicly disclosed. Historically exports ~15-20% of revenue.

pli_scheme.evidence: Government's PLI scheme for auto components cited in Bosch India's FY25 annual report as encouraging and underpinning strategic investments; Bosch India participates in advanced auto components/EV components PLI.

china_plus_one.evidence: Company exports to 90+ countries with dominant US presence (~55% of revenue); described as the only global manufacturer with full backward integration for solar control films. No explicit China+1 or supply-chain diversification framing found in public disclosures.

govt_capex.evidence: Solar control and industrial films may have incidental exposure to solar energy capex, but no government capex revenue disclosed in public filings.

rate_sensitive.evidence: Company is debt-free with zero net debt and cash reserves of approximately Rs 650 crore as of FY2025; no floating rate liabilities.

crude_exposure.evidence: Primary raw materials are Pure Terephthalic Acid (PTA) and Mono-ethylene Glycol (MEG), both petrochemical derivatives directly linked to crude oil prices. Procured from Indian refiners at import parity prices. Exact raw material cost as % of revenue not publicly disclosed for FY2025.

inr_exposure.hedging_policy: Forward contracts used to mitigate raw material price volatility; USD revenue hedging approach not explicitly quantified in public sources.
inr_exposure.evidence: Approximately 77% of FY2025 consolidated revenue is from exports (predominantly USD-denominated); geographically ~55% from Americas, ~12% Europe.

pli_scheme.evidence: Specialty polyester films sector not covered under India's PLI scheme as of FY2025; no PLI benefit disclosed.

rate_sensitive.evidence: Company is debt-free with zero long-term borrowings; minimal current liabilities primarily trade payables. No floating rate debt.

crude_exposure.evidence: API and pharmaceutical intermediate costs influenced by Chinese API prices. Exact raw material cost as % of revenue not publicly disclosed for FY2025.

inr_exposure.evidence: Approximately 90% of FY2025 revenue of Rs 2,034 crore is from exports across 23 countries; Latin America (~76%) and Africa (~6%) are key markets with US growing to ~17-21% of revenue.

pli_scheme.evidence: No PLI scheme benefit disclosed for Caplin Point in FY2025 public filings.

rural.evidence: Radico Khaitan distributes through 100,000+ retail outlets across India; Regular segment (mass-market) rebounded sharply in Q3-Q4 FY25 after 9 quarters of degrowth, indicating rural/semi-urban recovery. Exact rural revenue % not disclosed but Regular/mass market volumes are primarily rural/semi-urban.

rate_sensitive.evidence: Company has reduced debt significantly; exact floating rate debt % not disclosed in public sources for FY2025.

crude_exposure.evidence: Primary raw materials are Extra Neutral Alcohol (ENA, grain-derived) and glass packaging. ENA/grain prices were volatile in FY2024 but relatively stable in H2 FY2025. Crude oil exposure is indirect via glass and packaging. Exact raw material cost % of revenue not quantified.

inr_exposure.evidence: Approximately 9% of revenue (~Rs 436 crore on FY2025 net revenue of ~Rs 4,851 crore) is from international/export markets to 100+ countries and 35+ travel retail locations globally.

pli_scheme.evidence: No PLI scheme benefit disclosed; IMFL/spirits sector is not covered under India's PLI scheme.

rural.evidence: Nestle India reaches 216,000 villages as of FY2025, claiming the highest rural reach among FMCG peers. Company has pivoted toward a 'RUrban' strategy with volume-led growth in rural hinterlands. Maggi noodles delivered double-digit volume growth led by rural market share gains. Exact rural revenue % not quantified.

rate_sensitive.evidence: Nestle India is essentially debt-free (D/E 0.0055); short-term borrowings Rs 730.86 crore and long-term borrowings Rs 22.48 crore as of March 2025. Company disclosed it is not exposed to significant interest rate risk as borrowings are short-term at agreed rates.

crude_exposure.evidence: Key commodities include edible oils, milk and derivatives, spices, and packaging materials (some crude-linked). Gross margin contracted ~230-250 bps YoY to ~54-55% in FY2025 due to high commodity prices including edible oil. Exact raw material cost as % of revenue not disclosed.

inr_exposure.evidence: Export sales Rs 784.83 crore vs domestic sales Rs 19,292.67 crore in FY2025; exports to 28 countries. Company's primary forex exposure is on import of raw materials rather than revenue.

pli_scheme.evidence: Nestle India received Government of India approval for its proposal under the PLI scheme for food processing (processed fruits and vegetables category). Exact PLI incentive revenue not disclosed for FY2025.

rural.evidence: NAM-INDIA 'Beyond 30 cities' AUM is 18.2% of total MAAUM in FY2025, reflecting retail penetration beyond Tier-1 cities. Not directly analogous to rural revenue %.

govt_capex.evidence: Nippon India manages the CPSE ETF with AUM of ~Rs 20,592 crore, and EPFO routes equity investments through Nippon India ETFs. Government-linked AUM represents a meaningful but not separately disclosed portion of total AUM.

rate_sensitive.evidence: NAM-INDIA has zero debt (D/E ~0.001). However, as an AMC, interest rate changes significantly impact debt fund AUM: rising rates reduce bond prices, compressing debt fund AUM and management fee income.

inr_exposure.evidence: NAM-INDIA earns management fees on domestic Indian mutual fund AUM of Rs 5.57 lakh crore (March 2025). No USD revenue exposure.

pli_scheme.evidence: Financial services/asset management is not covered under India's PLI scheme.
